title: Evaluation of the derived subsequence compositor
statement:
For subsequences r,s, index m and a derived system P over B_(s.trans r), evaluation at m of the canonical extension compositor, followed by composite-selection tensor evaluation and transport along t_(s.trans r)(m)=t_s(t_r(m)), equals tensor evaluation of the first extension, tensor extension of the second evaluation, and the canonical derived scalar associator. The equality uses the actual derived tensor associator and the actual extension mate, without assuming coefficient flatness.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [EssentiallySmall.{w} C]
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (S : SystemScalarAssignment (J := J))
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w}) (r s : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
theorem systemSelectedDerivedComposition_eval (m : ℕ)
    (P : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem (selectedSystemRings B (s.trans r)))) :
    (derivedSystemEvaluation B m).map
        ((systemSelectedDerivedComposition S (systemTensorCoherence S) B r s).hom.app P) ≫
      (systemSelectedDerivedBelow B (s.trans r) m S (systemTensorCoherence S)).hom.app P ≫
      eqToHom (systemSelectedTensor_trans S B r s m P) =
    (systemSelectedDerivedBelow B r m S (systemTensorCoherence S)).hom.app
        ((systemSelectedDerivedExtension (selectedSystemRings B r) s S
          (systemTensorCoherence S)).derived.obj P) ≫
      (systemDerivedTensor S B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1).map
        ((systemSelectedDerivedBelow (selectedSystemRings B r) s (systemNextSelected r m)
          S (systemTensorCoherence S)).hom.app P) ≫
      ((systemTensorCoherence S).derivedAssoc B (systemNextSelected_spec r m).1
        (r.monotone (systemNextSelected_spec s (systemNextSelected r m)).1)).hom.app
        ((derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B (s.trans r))
          (systemNextSelected s (systemNextSelected r m))).obj P)
```

proof.text: Reindex composite evaluation to c=t_s(t_r(m)). Its transpose normalization remains the original normalization by equality transport. The selected-evaluation compositor equation, subsequence-transition equation, and actual transition composition law show that the three right evaluation squares paste with the scalar restriction compositor. Apply the general evaluation-composition theorem for normalized adjunction mates. Its uniqueness comparison is the specified extension compositor; the scalar comparison is the canonical tensor associator. The reindexing lemma inserts exactly the equality transport in the conclusion.
